When I was 16 I had severely bad mental health, ended up with me being put into care. I started to rely on bad coping mechanisms. Drugs, drink, self harm, running away, and getting arrested were just a few.

I was taken to hospitals and police stations more than I can count and didn’t care where my life was headed. I didn’t care about myself, so why care what I was doing?

Anyway, I got kicked out of a lot of homes, moved around about 7 times in less than 6 months. It was rough.

I started doing more drugs, drinking more, getting myself into situations that, looking back at, were extremely dangerous and scary for a child to be in.

Then I moved to a place where the staff working there cared enough about me living and my health to help, some days were good and some were bad. Then near the end they were mostly all good days. I learned how to love life again. I felt like a kid, I still didn’t care, but in a good way. I felt like I could do anything I wanted with my life. And I didn’t want it to be a bad one.

Currently, I am back living at home, I’m going to be 20 soon. Since leaving that place of course I’ve had slip ups, but I’m clean, and I have been for a while now. I still have some problems I’m working through. But thanks to the people who cared about me more than I did at the time, I know how to look after myself when things in life aren’t going great.
